li.label: a bed for when I was sick
li.description: While I was ill I had a sickbed of my own, and someone looked in on me every few hours with water.

li.label: healroot put by
li.description: Bundles of healroot drying in the storeroom, enough for the next fever and the one after.

li.label: something fresh in the stores
li.description: Vegetables and grain in the stores again, after weeks of nothing but meat. Even the plain stuff tastes like a feast day.

li.label: hot tea while I was sick
li.description: Hot tea when I was laid up, held in both hands under the blanket until it went cold.

li.label: a way to turn back the years
li.description: A biosculpter pod, here in the colony. I put my hand on the lid and thought about my knees at twenty.

li.label: an evening at the strangers' fire
li.description: Sat at the campers' fire till late, listening to news from places I'll never see. They passed their pot around and I took a turn.

li.label: the council sat down together
li.description: I asked for a meeting and got one. I said my piece from start to finish without being cut off.

li.label: everyone at one table
li.description: Supper with a chair for each of us, all of us eating at once. You had to shout to be heard down the table.

li.label: someone to teach
li.description: I have an apprentice now. They make every mistake I made at that age, and they're learning fast.

li.label: food that keeps
li.description: The stores have food in them that won't spoil, stacked and counted. If the fields fail, we'll still eat.

li.label: a voice from outside
li.description: A trader's voice came over the console last night, from somewhere far past the hills. I stayed up listening to the static afterward.

li.label: a bed for our guests
li.description: There's a bed made up for guests now, with a folded blanket at the foot. Whoever knocks next won't sleep on the floor.

li.label: a fishing spot
li.description: There's a place by the water where I can sit with a line and wait. It's the quietest hour of my day.

li.label: the stars up close
li.description: A whole night at the telescope. There's a ringed world up there, and a smudge of light that might be a thousand stars.

li.label: my tools in their place
li.description: Every tool hangs on its own hook in the cabinet now. I reached for the small file today without looking.

li.label: stone ready to build with
li.description: A good stack of cut stone, squared and waiting. I've already drawn the new wall in the dirt twice.

li.label: a drill to go deeper
li.description: We have a deep drill now. Whatever is down there, I'll be the one who finds it.

li.label: the animals penned
li.description: The animals have a proper pen now. I counted them in at dusk and the number came out right.

li.label: a grill in the yard
li.description: The grill's built. The first meat off it was smoky and black at the edges, the way I'd pictured it all week.

li.label: somewhere cool in the heat
li.description: On the worst afternoons I go and stand by the cooler with my eyes shut. I can breathe again.

li.label: a sauna for the cold
li.description: We built a sauna, and I was the first one in. I sat on the hot bench until my ears went red.

li.label: a soft chair for old bones
li.description: An armchair at last, soft enough to sink into, with arms to push myself up from.

li.label: a resting place ready
li.description: My resting place is built and waiting. I went to look at it this morning, and the work on the lid is good.

li.label: a grown-up is teaching me
li.description: I'm getting lessons from the best one in the whole colony. I got it right three times today.

li.label: a new animal to look after
li.description: We've got a new animal and I'm helping look after it. I've already picked a name, but I'm not telling.

li.label: new stories to read
li.description: New books, ones I've never read. I read the first one twice before supper.

li.label: a real floor at last
li.description: My room has a proper floor now, not bare dirt. I walked across it barefoot just to feel it.

li.label: a scarecrow in the fields
li.description: The scarecrow's up, in an old hat with its arms out over the rows. The crops look like ours again.
